counting_note: The televised hour-long A Very Sunny Christmas is one continuous work but occupies two official episode units, S06E13 and S06E14. Mediaphile preserves two linked ledger records without inventing a transcript split. This yields the corpus counting rule of 178 official episode units through S17E08 and 184 through released S18E06. Third-party guides that count the Christmas work differently may be off by one; do not normalize silently.
evidence_boundary: TEXT_INGESTED does not imply AUDIOVISUAL_INGESTED. Genuine production scripts are marked SCRIPT_INGESTED only when a substantially complete production artifact was actually read. METADATA_INGESTED or SECONDARY_ANALYSIS_INGESTED does not imply released dialogue was read.
